・Your battle against [Mordred] will be divided into two halves.

In the second half, they will release their Noble Phantasm and launch a powerful AOE attack.

・[Mordred] has a high resistance to NP Seal.
Try immobilizing or Charge Gauge-reducing moves to keep them from launching their Noble Phantasm.

[Goddess Rhongomyniad] (Lancer)

・When [Goddess Rhongomyniad]'s Charge Gauge is full, she'll unleash a powerful AOE attack with her Noble Phantasm.
Her Noble Phantasm has an Ignore Invincible effect, so you can't block it via Evade or Invincible.

・Anti-Enforcement DEF is effective against Noble Phantasms with Ignore Invincible.
If you can use Nullify Buff to cancel out the Ignore Invincible effect, Evade and Invincible will work again.

・[Goddess Rhongomyniad] can use skills to increase her Charge Gauge.
Watch out for sudden, unexpected Noble Phantasm attacks.

・[Zeus] possesses powerful resistance to attacks, making it difficult to deal damage. In addition to the main body, there are two separate parts, [Uranus] and [Gaia], and defeating them will lower his resistance.

・To target each body part, you must use a special Master Skill unique to this battle to switch targets.

・[Uranus] and [Gaia] frequently use skills that buff the main [Zeus] body, and even if defeated, they will be revived by [Zeus]'s skills.

・Breaking [Zeus]'s first HP Gauge will place the entire player's side under Skill Seal and NP Seal.

・Breaking [Zeus]'s second HP Gauge will max out his Charge Gauge and grant him Sure Hit status.

・He also has various status effects, such as Debuff Immune and resistance to Critical attacks, and these effects are reapplied every time an HP Gauge is broken.

・Breaking the first HP Gauge removes [Kirschtaria]'s own debuffs and all Buffs from the player's side.

・Breaking the second HP Gauge removes [Kirschtaria]'s own debuffs and also maxes out his Charge Gauge.

[Altria]'s Noble Phantasm has a debuff removal effect, so make sure to take advantage of this.

title: Strategy Hint

・You win in this quest by breaking [Black Wolf]'s HP Gauge one time.

・[Mash] and [Altria] provide good support as NPCs, so make sure you add attacker Servants to your party.

・[Black Wolf] has resistance to all attacks.
He also recovers HP every turn, so a strategy that deals heavy instantaneous damage is key.

・[Black Wolf] inflicts debuffs like Fear and Charm to the player's side while granting himself various buffs at the same time.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

・[Dragon Corpse of Albion] applies one Dragon's Will effect to itself every turn.
The more Dragon's Will it has, the more its ATK, NP Strength, and Damage Cut will rise.

・You can use buff removal effects on Dragon's Will.

・When you break its first HP Gauge, it will grant itself 5 Evade statuses.

・When you break its second HP Gauge, it will max out its Charge Gauge as well as boost its DEF.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Enemy Composition:
[Demonic Dog Barghest] (Saber)

・[Demonic Dog Barghest] inflicts powerful debuffs at the start of battle.
You can nullify these debuffs if the NPC [Mash] is among your starting members.

・The skills [Demonic Dog Barghest] uses have powerful effects, such as "Inflict Burn on all enemies and removes 3 Buffs," "Absorb a single enemy's NP," or "Inflict Stun and Curse on a single enemy." It uses these skills in a set order.

・The NPCs [Gawain] and [Lancelot] possess effects that support the entire player's side while they're on the field.
If one of these Knights of the Round Table members is a Servant, the effect will be even more profound.

・Breaking [Demonic Dog Barghest]'s first HP Gauge will remove all buffs from the entire player's side as well as reduce their resistance to debuffs and Death.

・Breaking its second HP Gauge drains the NP of the entire player's side.
It'll also fill up [Demonic Dog Barghest]'s Charge Gauge by up to 3 units depending on the amount of NP drained.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Enemy Composition:
[Enshrined Deity Cernunnos] (Berserker)

・[Enshrined Deity Cernunnos] applies 7 Layered Curse to himself at the start of battle and applies one more every turn.

・The number of Layered Curse applied to him will affect how much resistance he has against all types of attacks, as well as how powerful his skills are.

・Attack [Enshrined Deity Cernunnos] to remove his Layered Curse, one at a time.
Each time you remove one, he inflicts debuffs like Layered Curse Corruption and DEF Down, as well as applies a Curse to the entire player's side.

・Breaking his first HP Gauge inflicts a 1-turn Skill Seal and NP Seal on the entire player's side.
These effects cannot be removed with Remove Debuff.

・Breaking his second HP Gauge increases his Critical Rate and applies 5 Layered Curse to him.

・Breaking his third HP Gauge inflicts an effect on all players that reduces their NP by 10% each turn, as well as granting him 7 Layered Curse.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

title: Strategy Hint
message:

・If the ally [Nitocris (Alter)] is on the field, she will invoke an [Oath], and if the player's Servants follow it, it can extend the number of turns until [Underworld Scales] is activated. However, the turn countdown goes down faster if the Servants do not follow the [Oath].

title: Strategy Hint
message:

・Certain attacks by ally [Gorgon] or [Hessian Lobo] will apply a [Beast Hunting] state to the opponent, which will suppress additional attacks while in effect.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・The angel will grant good wishes, while the devil will grant evil wishes. These contrasting traits may lead to catastrophe...

・You may be inflicted with Good or Evil traits (treated as Debuffs) when you attack the angel and the devil.

・Special Defense against Good and Evil will be applied if you break the Gauge.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・A confectionary sales war has erupted in Restoration City SAITAMA! At the start of every turn, you will be forced to buy a confection.

・If you buy a [Restoration Manjyu], you will receive [Cordial] treatment from Takasugi Heavy Industries. When in a [Cordial] state, you will receive either a Buff or Debuff depending on Takasugi Heavy Industries' business results.

・The person who takes care of the company ledger is indispensable. Which means, if you take them down first...

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・Vanquishing enemies will earn you [Vanquish Points].

・You will win the battle once you collect over 100 Vanquish Points.

・When the enemy activates Guts 7 times, the "Holy Grail Manifestation" activates. The HP of the player's Servant on the front line will completely recover and will be in a [Holy Grail Obtained] state.

・If a Servant in a [Holy Grail Obtained] state is defeated, the "Holy Grail Capture" is activated, and the Holy Grail will go to the opposing team.

・If the player defeats an enemy in a [Holy Grail Obtained] state, the amount of [Vanquish Points] gained will increase. However, be warned that you will not be able to do Formation Changes. If the enemy is in the [Holy Grail Obtained] state, their NP Charge will increase every turn.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Drop 'em before they drop you!

・In this quest, enemies and allies both possess [Floating Power].

・As long as they have Floating Power, Servants can survive even if their HP reaches 0. But if Floating Power is gone, they will fall and receive a penalty.

・Floating Power will deplete after turns, when attacking enemies, and will greatly deplete when sustaining an attack from enemies. 

Deplete the enemies' Floating Power before your allies run out of Floating Power.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Choose a stepping stone to cross the lake!

・In this quest, you must find a golem that might be stable footing to cross the lake. 

・Breaking the golem's HP Gauge can tell you if it's the right or wrong one. If you've found the right one, you can go on and defeat it and jump on it to proceed.

・Choosing the wrong golem means someone is disguised as a golem using genjutsu. Even if you choose the wrong one, you can still proceed as long as you can defeat them, but be careful, as some of them are quite strong.

・And finally, something suspicious is lurking at the end of the course...

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Protect the cacao by stopping Jaguar Warrior!

・Jaguar Warrior is eyeing the cacao offered at the shrine altar. Signal to Quetzalcoatl, who is protecting the shrine, to stop Jaguar Warrior.

・Jaguar Warrior will take preparatory actions for her next move at the beginning of the turn. Signal to Quetzalcoatl by creating a Chain that would counter the actions. If communicated correctly, she will stop Jaguar Warrior from moving.

・When Jaguar Warrior has been stopped, she will be in a [Fall] (special incapacitation) state. You will deal much more damage while she is in this state, so this will be your chance to attack! Repeatedly putting her in this state will gradually increase the number of turns they are incapacitated for.

・The success rate for a Fall will change depending on the type of Chain. Mighty Chains may be easy to create, but the success rate for a Fall is low. However, your success rate will increase every time you fail. Quick, Arts, Buster, and Brave Chains will be difficult to make, but if coordinated with the upcoming action, you will always succeed at setting up a Fall.

・If inflicting Fall fails, Jaguar Warrior will steal the cacao. You will be able to retrieve the cacao through Fall. Be warned: if she steals cacao three times in a row, Jaguar Warrior will grow stronger.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Keep forcing the bombs that are about to explode onto the enemy!

・In this quest, there is a [Bomb] that will cause Servants to leave the field immediately when it explodes.

・If you attack the opponent while possessing the Bomb, you will force that enemy to take hold of the Bomb. You can only carry one Bomb at a time.

・Bombs will explode after a certain amount of turns. Ordinary Bombs will show how many turns are left, but there are some dangerous ones for which you can't tell...

・The Bomb will explode either at the end of the player or enemy turn. The bomb will explode depending on who took it first.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Force the pirates back with the cannons!

・In this quest, Master Skills will turn into special [Cannon Skills]. Cannon Skills can greatly lower the enemy's resistance and inflict great damage. Use the Cannon Skills wisely to drive back the pirates trying to board your ship.

・There are a total of three Cannon Skills. You can use them each turn, but only one at a time. Their effective ranges vary, so be strategic in your choices about which to use based on the enemy's placement.

・Additionally in this quest, the enemy's spawn behavior will be based on a special rule. Even if there may be an open spot on the field, an enemy may not necessarily spawn. If there are multiple openings, an enemy may spawn at a random location.

・Because the placement of the enemies on the field changes sporadically based on when the enemies are defeated as well as the random spawns, you will need to select the best Cannon Skill to effectively defeat enemies.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Run through the forest shrouded by genjutsu!

・This quest is made up of a total of ten areas.

・Defeating the enemies in each area will allow you to gain special Buffs. Only one effect can be gained from one area. Decide carefully which enemy to defeat to gain the best effect as you proceed.

・In some areas midway through, there will be enemies with the special effect [Book of Disillusion]. The Book of Disillusion Debuffs the especially powerful enemy waiting at the end of the forest. The Book of Disillusion will be lost if the Servant holding it is defeated, so make sure the Servant holding it is not defeated.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this quest, both allies and enemies will have a [Weak Point] that can be destroyed when sustaining certain attacks.

・Destroying the Weak Point will generate a penalty that drastically changes the battle situation. Prevent your allies' Weak Point from being destroyed as you aim to destroy the enemy's Weak Point.


■To destroy the Weak Point...

【Player】
　If you do not attack during a turn, a [Power Charge] state will be activated at the end of turn. One Power Charge will grant a chance, while two Power Charges will guarantee destroying the opponent's Weak Point with an attack.

【Enemy】
　Noble Phantasms and normal attacks after using certain special skills will destroy the opponent's Weak Point.

■To protect the Weak Point...

【Player】
　Allies with [DEF Up] or [Damage Cut] will put up a [Barricade] at the end of turn. With a Barricade up, the Weak Point will not be destroyed even when sustaining an attack from the enemy. If the DEF Up or Damage Cut is removed while the Barricade is up, the Barricade effect will disappear.
　Barricades will have a limit to how many times it can protect the Weak Point.
*Effects from Class Skills or Craft Essences will not create a Barricade.

【Enemy】
　Enemies will have a [Hyper Barricade] that is stronger than Barricades. When the enemies have DEF Up or Damage Cut applied, they are able to prevent the Weak Point from being destroyed indefinitely. Before trying to destroy their Weak Point, try to think of a strategy to deal with the defensive effects.

■About penalties...

【Player】
　If the Weak Point is destroyed, normal attacks using Command Card will be disabled. Skills and Noble Phantasms are usable.

【Enemy】
　If the Weak Point is destroyed, they will sustain massive damage.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

・The NP Gauge will be full and C. Stars will be given, so use skills to maximize your firepower.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

・Attila the San(ta) will apply powerful buffs to all enemies when she is defeated.

・There will be enemies who inflict (Curse), so bring along Servants who can remove status ailments.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this quest, there will be boss and minions, and the quest will be cleared once the boss enemy is defeated. There is no need to defeat the minions, but your HP will recover when they are defeated, so use this to your benefit.

・The boss will inflict a large amount of Curses and Debuffs. The more Curses are inflicted, the stronger the Debuffs. On the other hand, there are also types of Debuffs that will be inflicted only when you are not Cursed, so be mindful of the number of Curses stacked on you as you battle.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

title: Strategy Hint
message:

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this year-end party, numerous Santas (?) participate. Each will strengthen all enemies and allies when they enter and exit the field.

・Be careful when dismissing a certain Santa-related person appearing first, as the player side will sustain damage or Buffs will be removed over a set number of turns when they leave.

・The final host of the year-end party possesses strong resistance to damage and intends to see the party through to the very end, so it's advised to ask the other participants to leave first.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this Quest, special states will be applied to enemies, and enemies will perform specific actions based on these states.

[Release Sword's Spirit]
Enemies typically use an Extra Attack instead of a Noble Phantasm when their Charge reaches maximum, but if 5 or more of these statuses are applied, the enemy will deploy their Noble Phantasm after their Charge is full, consuming these 5 states. Be careful, as this effect can still be applied even after the enemy's HP Gauge is broken.

[Accompanying Battle Cry]
Expending 1 of these effects can call up 1 Rogue Servant. Rogue Servants will leave after a set amount of turns. When a Rogue Servant's Charge reaches maximum, they will use their Noble Phantasm instead of attacking with an Extra Attack.

[Tool Preparation]
Expending 1 of these effects will either heal or enhance.

[Oni of the Blade]
If the enemy's Guts is activated on the first turn, the enemy will grow much stronger, triggering Ultra High Difficulty mode.

・Be careful: if any 2 enemies (excluding Rogue Servants) reach maximum Charge simultaneously, the [Special Technique Resonance] activates, and they will focus their attacks on one of the player's Servants.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this Quest, you and enemy Andromeda will receive guidance and lessons in how to be a hero from three instructors.

・The instructors appear one at a time, conducting lessons for a set number of turns. Once the lesson ends, they depart, strengthening all allies and enemies. Be careful: if you defeat them before the lesson concludes, they will only strengthen the enemy Andromeda before they leave.

・If the previous class progresses too quickly ahead of schedule, the last instructor to appear becomes overly motivated, resulting in a stricter lesson than usual...

・You cannot defeat the enemy Andromeda until the instructors' lessons are complete, so finish their lectures first and face her last.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

The [Trojan Horse] works advantageously to the player's side right when the status is applied, but there is 1 trap hidden.

・The [Trojan Horse] that is a trap will change into a Debuff after a turn.
There is no visual indication that it is a trap, but Remove Debuff can be used.

・Odysseus will strengthen himself with various protections, such as Invincible, but when the trap [Trojan Horse] is activated, he will go on the offensive and he will be more susceptible to attacks.

・Breaking Odysseus's HP Gauge once will result in him fully filling his Charge to the max and deploying his Noble Phantasm that Removes DEF Buffs. For a short time after the battle begins, the player's Buff Removal Resistance goes down, so take precautions to avoid taking direct hits.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this Quest, enemy [Sunken Ship Treasure Chest] and Teach, who seeks it, appear. Defeat Teach to clear the Quest and gain a large amount of QP.

・If Teach or the player's Servant defeat a [Sunken Ship Treasure Chest], they obtain either a [Supreme Treasure] Buff or a [Cursed Treasure] Debuff. These two types of treasures can be stolen and forced onto allies or enemies.

・When Teach's HP gauge is broken, if the number of [Supreme Treasures] he possesses is low, he will use more powerful skills.

・Damage dealt to Teach is reduced immediately after battle begins. Damage becomes easier to deal each time a certain number of [Sunken Ship Treasure Chests] are destroyed, so prioritize acquiring the treasures first.

■How to Steal [Supreme Treasure]

【Player】
1 can be stolen by attacking Teach with a Noble Phantasm. If he is incapacitated, you can also steal 1 without a Noble Phantasm attack.

【Enemy】
Teach can steal 1 treasure from the target by attacking with a Critical or Noble Phantasm. If a Player's Servant is defeated, all the treasure the defeated Servant held will be taken. When Teach's Gauge is broken, he will also start using special skills that can directly steal [Supreme Treasure].

■How to Push [Cursed Treasure] to Others

【Player】
Attacking Teach with a Noble Phantasm will push 1 onto him.

【Enemy】
 When Teach holds a certain number of [Cursed Treasures], he will use a special skill that will push the [Cursed Treasure] onto the player.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Master, didja hear? Seems weird ghosts show up around these parts.

They appear when "kids" are playing, and they go away if you give them sweets. They wouldn't hurt a fly, if you ask me.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
I hear animal-loving ghosts show up. They come around animals like cats, rabbits, or tigers.

I wonder, why would there be tigers in Japan, anyway?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Get near it and it'll cut you down! Kotetsu's thirsty for blood tonight! Japanese ghosts like flying man-slayers sure are eerie! 

Huh? That's not Kotetsu? It's okay. It's all about intuition for stuff like this!

title: Strategy Hint
message:
This shrine's ghost seems to target men. But as long as they're pure, righteous, and a good person, gender doesn't matter. Feels like some old-fashioned trope.

What's wrong, Master? You're saying Aoko would fit the bill for that? Are you trying to look at something that can't be seen?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Huh. A corridor that you can't get through? Is this a rejection of one's identity? Well if that's the case, I suggest a cheat move of just flying over it! And then the enraged ghost approaches for a dogfight!!! 

By the way, this is supposed to be a fighter plane battle, so why's it called a dogfight?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
This room's ghost seems to have some weird obsession? Like being obsessed with a certain kind of face or something. I can't take my eyes off my own angel either, for so many reasons.

By the way, what's up with that lame-ass loner's doll-making skills? Did they acquire the skill through some kind of part-time job?
If they can mass-produce themselves like machines, wouldn't they be super popular with this room's ghost too?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Mirror, mirror, the fairest one of all is my angel. The fake Alice also stole my heart too, what with the mom vibes.

Hey Master, interested in seeing yourself in another form too? Just be careful getting too close to mirrors since you might end up multiplying. 

Now that I think of it, I think I saw a bird that looked just like me flying near a guy in green. Maybe I just imagined it.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
This here's the room of a poor ghost tortured by deadlines. I recommend concealing your presence to get close. 

For some reason, temptation is everywhere in the days leading up to deadlines; new games, fun anime, thrilling comics. Classic novels are good too, and even fairy tales too, sometimes. Writers always seek inspiration. Please forgive me.

(Gasp) Did I just say something?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Someone getting spirited away isn't an everyday occurrence. And if you do get caught up in somethin' like that, you just have to accept that your luck was either REAL good or bad.

I'm a blue bird of happiness, so I'm going to be taking Alice. One day. Probably. Oh, don't worry about Aoko. Based on her daily habits, I'd wager she wanders off anyway, no trickery involved!

title: Strategy Hint
message:
So there's apparently some sort of violent ghost that kills other ghosts...scary. Local oni and yokai seem to all be meeting their fate. If you don't wanna get targeted, just keep your head down, okay? As they say, you only grow up by getting up to turn on the telly!

Not a fan of 80s jokes, eh? But I've got plenty of them!

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Murder at the Kumano Hot Springs is now complete! This calls for a celebratory toast! I hear even the ghosts are partying and making a racket.

Huh? You wanna join in? Modern humans have no fear, I guess. But that's the spirit. I don't know where the banquet hall is, but if your magical energy is at an ace-level high, you might just find it?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
A powerful ghost that targets tongues has appeared! If it cuts your tongue and renders you unable to speak, it'll strip you bare. That's the Tongue-Cutting Sparrow. Even for someone drowned in greed, they're way too aggressive. Why do humans always think the grass is greener on the other side? 

--------------------------------------------
・When combating the ghosts, you will be inflicted Skill Seal, so be prepared to counter it.
・Be careful, as the enemy will remove Buffs at specific times too.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
When a local lumberjack cut down a tree, some ghost apparently came out and got super angry. The ghost refuses to leave the tree, so the lumberjack managed to escape, or so the story goes. But this time it's the opposite. The ghost's going to get taken down! We're gonna chop down everything that's important to it! You gutless weakling, it's lumberjack time!

--------------------------------------------
・The ghost will revive when defeated, but with a heavy price. Continuing to defeat it until the ghost can no longer afford the cost is one option to win.
・The ghost of the tree possesses powerful damage cut, and so half-hearted attacks won't defeat it.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
Do not open the room under any circumstance, okay? The cleaning lady told me this room is cursed. If you don't have a countermeasure against curses, you'd better come back to it later. Huh? You didn't hire a cleaning lady? It's definitely a ghost? Gyaaaah! Go get a priest, quick!

------------
・Defeat the ghost controlling the 16 souls to win.
・If the ghost uses its Noble Phantasm, it will perform an Order Change, preventing you from attacking. 
・Attacking the 16 souls will curse you, so don't forget to set up countermeasures against curses.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
This is it! Only One, pedal to the metal, no holds barred! And the number one Shiny Star! Since all five wishes have obviously come true, even Master won't be able to beat it! And if you do manage to win, I wouldn't mind a dunk in a hot spring!

--------------------------------------------
・Shiny Star's five abilities allow it to reduce its own turn duration by landing Noble Phantasm attacks and Critical Hits. 
・Landing a set number of Critical Hits and Noble Phantasm attacks, Shiny Star's output decreases and it weakens, so aggressively try to land Noble Phantasms and Critical Hits.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
A demon of destruction more terrifying than any ghost has appeared... I think you already know this, Master, but this is absolutely Aoko's irrational behavior.

“I'm going to power up using abilities from the future!” 
“I'll return the borrowed abilities right away!” 

Oh, is that so? But you know she's going to take all those statements back the moment she gets backed into a corner and things are down to the wire. I can totally see that happening!

--------------------------------------------
・Test your strength against Aozaki Aoko.
・Aoko won't use her Noble Phantasm until the final gauge. Instead, she'll apply a defensive buff to herself, so you will need to time your attacks carefully.
・Aoko borrows power from her future self to super-enhance herself. However, after a certain number of turns after the enhancement, a debuff proportional to her boosted abilities will be applied to Aoko. 
・At her final gauge, she will use her Noble Phantasm to become Super Aoko to fight. Since AOE attacks are part of her normal actions, be prepared for them at any time.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・Numerous test subjects appear in this quest.

・When a subject's HP reaches 0, it will inject itself with a drug and transform into a more powerful form. Beware of the powerful skills they use after transforming.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・In this quest, the Labors of Heracles are recreated each turn, enhancing the enemy Heracles or weakening the player's Servants.

・The Labors have various effects, such as granting Ignore Invincible or Buff removal, and powering up Heracles's attacks as turns pass.

・Heracles has a powerful Guts status which grants him resistance to the attack that reduced his HP to zero. Certain activations of his Guts also trigger his unique Skills.

・You will win this battle by enduring all of the Labors, even if you do not defeat Heracles.

Of course, we wouldn't mind if you just beat him.

*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・Vanquishing enemies will earn you [Vanquish Points].

・You will win the battle once you collect over 100 Vanquish Points.

・When the enemy activates Guts 7 times, the "Holy Grail Manifestation" activates. The HP of the player's Servant on the front line will completely recover and will be in a [Holy Grail Obtained] state.

・If a Servant in a [Holy Grail Obtained] state is defeated, the "Holy Grail Capture" is activated, and the Holy Grail will go to the opposing team.

・If the player defeats an enemy in a [Holy Grail Obtained] state, the amount of [Vanquish Points] gained will increase. However, be warned that you will not be able to do Formation Changes. If the enemy is in the [Holy Grail Obtained] state, their NP Charge will increase every turn.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・Welcome to Ahnenerbe! We're glad to offer you heartfelt hospitality through our [Customer Service] and [Cuisine].

・Our [Customer Service] specialists respond with their own special skills when your Servant uses their abilities. These skills mainly enhance our own staff, but they can provide a little extra oomph for you, too!

・Our [Cuisine] specialists will serve you dishes that enhance the effectiveness of different command cards, depending on the specialist. Our cuisine is exquisite, trust me! However, once a staff member leaves, their dish will be taken off the menu. You will long for their dish, and your command cards' performance will subsequently decrease, so consider yourself warned, okay?

title: Strategy Hint
message:
- In this quest, you must defeat all enemies within 8 turns to win. Make sure you bring along ways to attack multiple enemies at once.

- Enemies are restrained by the effects of Xu Fu's spell for a period after the battle begins, preventing them from performing normal actions. They'll go on a rampage once the spell's restraint is lifted, so watch out.

title: Strategy Hint
message:

- In this quest, you'll face hostile birds pecking at your balloon. If they peck at it too many times, the balloon will burst and it's game over.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
- The staff at the Ehangwen beach house receive a special buff at the start of battle.

- The buff lasts as long as each staff member remains on the field, so tackle the opponents who're buffed in the most annoying ways first.

- The [Item Lender] handles rental items. When the Lender attacks you, you're afflicted with one of the following states in addition to taking damage: [Floatie], [Beach Chair], or [Beach Umbrella]. Each state wears off after a certain number of turns, but if you run out of uses before it does, the item breaks.

- Breaking rental items will, let's just say, get you in trouble.

- Once all staff members are eliminated, the owner of Ehangwen will appear.

title: Strategy Hint
message:
・At the simulator, a battle against the trio of Kazuradrop, Passionlip, and Meltryllis.

・Passionlip uses herself as a shield to grant her allies powerful damage resistance.
After taking enough hits, she becomes stunned, giving you an opening in her defense. It's up to you whether you defeat Passionlip first or use that gap in her defense to take out the others instead.

・Breaking the HP Gauge of Passionlip or Meltryllis will cause Kazuradrop, eagerly awaiting her opportunity, to spring into action.
Kazuradrop can absorb her allies to power herself up.
Once [Prepare to Absorb] begins, the only way to prevent it is to break Kazuradrop herself or defeat whoever she's trying to absorb.

・If Passionlip or Meltryllis are absorbed, Kazuradrop will be able to use their skills.
If she absorbs both of them, she'll be nigh unstoppable—the complete and perfect incarnation of Kazura.

[Nezha] (Berserker)

- [Nezha] uses powerful skills every turn until the 5th turn.

- At the start of the battle, she uses a skill that significantly reduces the player's ATK.

- On the 3rd turn, she uses a skill that inflicts Stun every turn.

- Endure the 5-turn onslaught and defeat [Nezha].
